person: Samira Okoye is a 32-year-old marketing project coordinator, married six weeks ago. She and her husband Tobias both took the surname Okoye-Hart. She lives with her 84-year-old father and handles most of the household admin. She is great with apps and lost on government sites. She sent in her own Social Security change a few weeks ago, but she has not touched her licence, passport, bank or payroll, and she doesn't know what order they go in. She has a Thanksgiving flight and a December work trip to Lisbon, and her husband and father both assume she has it all handled.
stated_up_front: Okay, I made a list! I got married in September and need my new name on everything: license, passport, bank, work. Can you tell me what order to do it in and what's actually urgent? I have a flight at Thanksgiving and a work trip to Lisbon in December.

facts.truth: Married 11 September 2026; she and her husband Tobias both now use Okoye-Hart. Her maiden name was Samira Okoye.
She filed her name change online and visited the field office on 28 September. Her new card arrived on 14 October, so her record shows Okoye-Hart.
He has not done anything yet. His record still shows Tobias Hart. He would like a visit around early November.
A standard licence in the name Samira Okoye, expiring in 2029, with no REAL ID star.
Issued 20 January 2026 in the name Samira Okoye, so it is under a year old.
A domestic flight on 25 November for Thanksgiving, and a work trip to Lisbon on 14 December booked through her employer's travel desk under her old name.
A checking and a savings account at Northfield Credit Union in her name. A joint account with Tobias and a separate account for her father's caregiver payroll.
She is an employee at a marketing agency, and payroll still shows Samira Okoye.
She wants to know what is urgent and which steps carry a penalty if late, and wants no surprise fees.
She pays two part-time caregivers out of pocket and has filed nothing for them. This is a separate worry from the name change.

unknowns: Whether the passport can be renewed free of charge, or which form applies, given the passport's age
Whether the licence office will accept the appointment before Tobias's Social Security record is updated, and in what order things must happen
Whether the name change affects her taxes or the name her employer reports wages under
Whether she is legally a household employer, what tax filings that requires, and whether she needs an accountant
